price_by_size: Instant Starter: one-time $5K account only (help.blueguardian.com/en/articles/18426780); fee not listed on help page. Blue Guardian blog advertises an $11 entry for the $5K Starter [uncertain, promo text]. Instant Standard: accounts $100K-$400K cited in help article (no price listed); homepage price table (with GUARD30 30% code, unlabelled plan) shows 5K $50 (list $72), 10K $70 (list $100), 25K $146 (list $208), 50K $227, 100K $436 [uncertain which plan]. Instant Standard reported retired/replaced by Direct in one third-party source [uncertain].
turkey_accepted: Official (help.blueguardian.com/en/articles/18426607) CFD restricted list: Afghanistan, Albania, Algeria, Cuba, Iran, Jordan, Libya, Myanmar, North Korea, Philippines, Senegal, Syria, Vietnam. Turkey NOT on the CFD list (Turkey is on the Futures restricted list only).
turkey_payout_kyc: KYC required before any payout. Payouts: crypto (up to $1,000 per request, min $100 CFD) or Rise (min $500, no max); Instant Starter crypto only; 3% processing fee; processed within 24 business hours. No Turkey-specific method stated [uncertain].
platform: CFD: MetaTrader 5 and Match Trader (US clients Match Trader only); TradeLocker no longer offered for new purchases (help.blueguardian.com/en/articles/18426740). cTrader not mentioned.
ea_clause_text: Instant Starter/Standard official text: "Expert Advisors: allowed, if they're your own setup." VPN and VPS permitted but not to evade copy/group/signal rules. Prohibited: HFT, tick scalping and arbitrage bots; reverse, latency and hedge arbitrage; trades must be held at least 2 minutes (tick scalp rule); copy trading only between accounts you legally own; margin usage above 80% treated as gambling; Guardian Shield closes trades at 1% combined floating loss (first trigger cuts profit split to 50%, second breaches account).
overnight_weekend: Official: "Overnight and weekends: allowed." Crypto-specific weekend rule not stated [uncertain].
swap_free_scope: No swap-free option mentioned on any Blue Guardian help or site page. Instant rules state drawdown includes closed profits and losses, swaps and commissions, i.e. swaps are charged. Crypto swap not specified [uncertain]. Does not meet swap-free requirement on official evidence.
us100_btc: Help article lists markets only as classes (FX, indices, gold/commodities, crypto); no symbol names (US100, BTCUSD not confirmed) [uncertain]. Leverage Instant Starter/Standard: FX 1:30, indices 1:10, commodities 1:10, crypto 1:2. Commission: indices $0, crypto $0. Lot limits not stated.
drawdown: Instant Starter ($5K): daily loss 3% (from higher of balance/equity at 5pm New York reset), max drawdown 5% trailing from highest closed balance (locks at start balance at +5%), 1% floating-loss Guardian Shield. Instant Standard: daily 3%, max drawdown 6% trailing (locks at +6%), 1% Guardian Shield. Drawdown based on closed balance incl. swaps and commissions.
consistency_min_days: Instant Starter: best day below 15% of total profit; at least 5 trading days with 0.5%+ profit. Instant Standard: best day below 20% (15% on $300K/$400K); at least 5 trading days at 0.5%+; after drawdown lock leave 1% of starting balance in profit when withdrawing.
first_payout: Instant Starter: one payout only, capped at $250 profit (90% fixed split = $225), crypto only, min $100, then account closes permanently. Instant Standard: on-demand after 5 profitable days, 80% split (90% with add-on), first two payouts capped $10K on $200K+ accounts.
news_gambling: Instant Starter: news trading allowed. Instant Standard: restricted 5 minutes before/after high-impact news on affected instruments (and FOMC any impact); profit may be removed, no breach. Gambling: margin use above 80% flagged; copy/coordinated trading across accounts prohibited.
